label: For "Contract Clause Risk Review": Read tender and contract documents, extract clauses on liability, payment, delay and change, compare them with company positions and flag risks with citations for legal counsel to decide. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Model memory of law.
